= xml-callout-subs(1)
:doctype: manpage
:revdate: 2026-10-06
:manmanual: Callout checks
:mansource: acdc
:icons: font
:value: café

== Name
xml-callout-subs - substitutions and XML markers

== Synopsis

[source,xml,line-comment=,subs="+macros,+quotes,+attributes"]
----
S01 {value} *Bold* <!--1-->
S02 link:https://example.org[Link] <!--.--> <.>
S03 pass:c[<!--2-->] <.>
S04 footnote:note[Note.] <!--.--> <.>
----
<.> XML remains literal after a link.
<.> Protected XML does not consume a number.
<.> Footnote before a callout.

[source,xml,line-comment=,subs="-callouts"]
----
S05 disabled <!--1--> <1>
S06 disabled \<!--2--> \<2>
----

[source,xml,subs="-callouts"]
----
S07 default disabled <!--1--> <1>
----

[literal,line-comment=,subs="+quotes"]
S08 *Bold* <!--1-->
S09 *Bold* <1>

<1> Styled literal paragraph.

[source,xml,subs="+macros"]
----
S10 restored <!--1-->
----
<1> Default recognition returns after disabled callouts.

Reuse footnote:note[].
